{{Youmay|a building material|the [[Memory-plastic|medical implement]]}}
'''Bi-state memory plastic''' was a building material used to create temporary buildings that could be broken down quickly and reassembled elsewhere. [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' [[Peregrine's Nest]] used bi-state memory plastic buildings.<ref name="DFRS">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> Bi-state memory plastic was also used to create [[emergency space seal]]s.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
